title: Entering the Game
summary: Three Sun family guardian elders and the clan's First Elder Sun Qiming trap Wang Lin in a Demon-Sealing Array over Sun Ning, until Wang Lin's Ascendant divine sense makes them back down and pay 200,000 immortal jade. While waiting, the young Sun Ling lectures 'Xu Mu' on hard work without knowing who he is, and Wang Lin finds it refreshing. Even with the jade he cannot reach mid Ascendant, so when Sun Qiming invites him to an auction with an eighth-grade demi-divine pill, he goes. Sun Tai warns him it is bait: four years earlier Sun Xi, Ran Xuefeng and the rogue cultivator Zhao Chuanwen killed a wounded Huan clan member for five such pills, and the Huan clan of Planet Thousand Illusion wipes out anyone tied to such a death. On Planet Thousand Illusion, the Huan ancestor Huan Wuqing orders everyone involved killed and hands the task to Huan Mei, his newly adopted final disciple from the Alliance, who sends the guard Huan Dong. Sun Xi tests Wang Lin's strength and escorts him to the auction, where the pill is the last item and no one dares bid until Wang Lin offers a single immortal jade.
events: The Sun elders trap Wang Lin; his Ascendant divine sense forces Sun Qiming to pay 200,000 immortal jade
Sun Ling innocently lectures Wang Lin about diligence
Sun Qiming invites him to an auction with an eighth-grade demi-divine pill
Sun Tai reveals the three ancestors killed a Huan clan member four years ago and want a scapegoat
Huan Wuqing orders everyone involved wiped out and gives the task to Huan Mei; Huan Dong is sent
Sun Xi tests Wang Lin, then escorts him to Baohe Hall
Wang Lin bids one immortal jade for the pill
cultivation: Sun Xu, Sun Huan, Sun Leng and Sun Qiming: peak Soul Transformation. Huan Dong: peak mid Ascendant. Wang Lin's 200,000 jade still is not enough for mid Ascendant.
